<thought>We need to find the retrosynthetic template that, when applied to the target product SMILES, yields the precursor pairs provided earlier. The product SMILES from the previous step is “C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO”. This reaction is a Still‑Gennari (HWE) olefination, which forms a C=C double bond and a carboxylic ester while breaking a C‑P bond, a C‑C bond, and a C‑O bond. We will search the template catalog for templates that match this forward reaction description and are applicable to the product molecule.
